query: SELECT column_name, full_data_type FROM `fe-bar-ir`.information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='silver' AND table_name='adjudications_history' AND column_name IN ('cited_clause_ids','finalized_at') ORDER BY column_name
array_shape_query: SELECT count(*) rows, count_if(cited_clause_ids IS NULL) null_arrays, count_if(size(cited_clause_ids)=0) empty_arrays, count_if(size(cited_clause_ids)>0) populated_arrays, min(size(cited_clause_ids)) min_size, max(size(cited_clause_ids)) max_size FROM `fe-bar-ir`.silver.adjudications_history WHERE __END_AT IS NULL
decisions: Parse native-CDF cited_clause_ids STRING into ARRAY<STRING> to preserve evaluator and Wave 4 consumer compatibility.
Cast native-CDF finalized_at TIMESTAMP_NTZ to the prior TIMESTAMP contract.
Exclude native-only data_provenance and baseline_loaded_at operational seed metadata from both silver histories.
Keep all remaining CDF-native types because strings, decimals, booleans, and dates exactly match the prior contract.
